description: Dessertes des parcours de métro du réseau STAR is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Liste des dessertes des parcours de métro du réseau STAR, comprenant notamment l'ordre de la desserte et l'autorisation de montée/descente. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. The portal shows 60 records. The portal shows 2014-11-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
